title: Muraja'ah: An-Nazi'at 1 to 24 with clean stops: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 27 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Muraja'ah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 27. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌۭ (٩) يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ (١٠) أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًۭا نَّخِرَةًۭ (١١) قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًۭا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌۭ (١٢) فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ (١٣) فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ (١٤) هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ (١٥) إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى (١٦) ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ (١٧) فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ (١٨)

questions.q: Chain recitation: each pupil recites one ayah of 79:9-24 in register order.
questions.a: 79:9-24 recited in order by the class.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 79:9-24 and one older surah to the teacher. Everyone else: 3-3-link the weakest ayat, then log revision.
questions.a: Rubric marked with one target for each pupil.

questions.q: Extend: write your own target from today's feedback in the portal response box. Start: 'Next time I will ...'
questions.a: For example: 'Next time I will hold the madd lazim in ٱلطَّآمَّةُ for six counts.'

questions.q: Which ayah comes after «فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْءَايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ»?
Recite An-Nazi'at 79:22 in your head. How does the next ayah begin?
Think again: Where in An-Nazi'at 1 to 24 would you most like to stop for breath, and is that a good place?
questions.a: At the ayah ends; inside 79:18 to 19 the question is long, so stop only at the end of 79:19.
